semanticPrograms.source:
import Std
universe u
namespace Demo
postfix:10000 "‼" => id
@[simp] def identity {α : Type u} (value : α) : α := value
def factorial : Nat → Nat | 0 => 1 | Nat.succ n => Nat.succ n * factorial n
def effect : IO Unit := pure ()
theorem identity_eq {α : Type u} (value : α) : identity value = value := by
  rfl
end Demo

From Stdlib Require Import Arith.
Module Demo.
Universe u.
#[local] Notation "'identity!' value" := value (at level 10).
Fixpoint factorial (n : nat) : nat := match n with | 0 => 1 | S rest => n * factorial rest end.
Theorem factorial_zero : factorial 0 = 1.
Proof. reflexivity. Qed.
End Demo.

renameCases.source: const x = 1; const object = { x: 2 }; globalThis.result = [Object.keys(object), object.x, x];

renameCases.source: const x = 1; const object = { x }; globalThis.result = [Object.keys(object), object.x, x];

renameCases.source: const object = { x: 1 }; const { x } = object; globalThis.result = x;
renameCases.expected: const object = { x: 1 }; const { x: value } = object; globalThis.result = value;

renameCases.source: const object = { x: 1 }; const { x: local } = object; globalThis.result = [local, object.x];
renameCases.expected: const object = { x: 1 }; const { x: value } = object; globalThis.result = [value, object.x];

renameCases.source: fn use_value(π: u64) -> u64 { let value = π; { let π = value; let _ = π; } π } // π
renameCases.expected: fn use_value(total: u64) -> u64 { let value = total; { let π = value; let _ = π; } total } // π

renameCases.source: def useValue (π : Nat) : Nat := let value := π; let π := value; π
renameCases.expected: def useValue (total : Nat) : Nat := let value := total; let π := value; π

renameCases.source: Definition use_value (π : nat) : nat := let value := π in let π := value in π.
renameCases.expected: Definition use_value (total : nat) : nat := let value := total in let π := value in π.

varScopeCases.source: function f() { if (true) { var x = 1; } return x; } globalThis.result = f();
varScopeCases.expected: function f() { if (true) { var y = 1; } return y; } globalThis.result = f();

varScopeCases.source: function f() { const before = x; var x = 1; return before; } globalThis.result = f() === undefined;
varScopeCases.expected: function f() { const before = y; var y = 1; return before; } globalThis.result = f() === undefined;

varScopeCases.source: function outer() { if (true) { var x = 1; } function inner() { var x = 2; return x; } return [x, inner()]; } globalThis.result = outer();
varScopeCases.expected: function outer() { if (true) { var y = 1; } function inner() { var x = 2; return x; } return [y, inner()]; } globalThis.result = outer();

varScopeCases.source: const f = () => { if (true) { var x = 1; } return x; }; globalThis.result = f();
varScopeCases.expected: const f = () => { if (true) { var y = 1; } return y; }; globalThis.result = f();
